_comment: Instance patterns for core/scripts/pending-clauses.py — phrases in YOUR rule language that make a sentence wait for a core state or a date (the English ones are built in). Run by brain-update.sh after every pin move; a clause whose PR is already in the pinned core is reported STALE, any other pending clause as READ, a forward date word followed by an ISO date before today as EXPIRED. Only FORWARD forms belong in date_words ('alpha until', 'valid until'): a bare 'until' in prose is mostly history. Regexes, case-insensitive. Replace the examples with your language's phrases or delete the file.
